messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature shown in three-quarter side view facing right, with a pale gray smooth-skinned axolotl-like head, neck, underbelly and legs, and a dark brown overlapping scaled covering like a pangolin over its arched back and long tapering tail. The head is broad and flat with large dark eyes, small nostrils and a slight smiling mouth, with pink feathery external gills on stalks behind the head on both sides. The belly is pale and ringed, the four sturdy legs end in clawed toes, and the scaled tail extends to the left out of frame.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale gray axolotl-like head with smooth moist skin and dark speckles", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right of the body"}, {"looks_like": "large round dark eyes with pale blue-gray rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pink feathery external gills on pale stalks with fine filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "on both sides of the neck just behind the head"}, {"looks_like": "short sturdy pale gray fleshy salamander-like limbs with wrinkled skin", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two front and two hind"}, {"looks_like": "broad toes with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping dark brown keratinous pangolin-like scales", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the back from behind the head to the tip of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale whitish-gray soft ringed skin", "part": "underbelly", "where": "along the underside between the legs"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering tail scaled on top", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the left rear of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
